title: Make an alteration finite over a modification
statement: Let $a:T\to S$ be an alteration of reduced Noetherian schemes [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]. There exist modifications $u:\widetilde T\to T$ and $v:S'\to S$ and a finite surjective morphism $p:\widetilde T\to S'$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] such that $a u=v p$. If $S$ is integral, the schemes $S'$ and $\widetilde T$ may be taken reduced, with $S'$ integral when $T$ is integral.

source.place: Lemma 2.5, p. 4 (flattening of an alteration). Local archival PDF WANTED; author PDF read online.
